svg.title: DropSync
svg.desc: Repository-grounded map of the Next.js collaboration app, FastAPI AI service, and Electron encrypted-vault companion. Source and configuration establish structure; deployed availability and runtime behavior were not tested.

g.title: stores and subscribes to drop records [observed]
fetches and uploads through r2 helper [observed]
imports into and exports from vault [observed]
Web application
g.desc: Browser entry point for drops, workspaces, collaboration, archives, and calls.. Purpose: Browser entry point for drops, workspaces, collaboration, archives, and calls.. How it works: Composes authentication and data hooks with Classic and Editorial layouts; anonymous visitors see the landing page.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/page.tsx: page imports and Home composition. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/page.tsx

g.title: Authentication
g.desc: Firebase user sign-in and account operations.. Purpose: Firebase user sign-in and account operations.. How it works: Uses Google popup and email/password Firebase Auth APIs; maintains user/profile records.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/auth.ts: signInWithGoogle; Firebase Auth imports. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/auth.ts

g.title: Drop lifecycle
g.desc: Create, decrypt, update, copy, move, and delete text and file drops.. Purpose: Create, decrypt, update, copy, move, and delete text and file drops.. How it works: Uses Firestore metadata, browser crypto and wrapped keys; requests signed uploads and object deletion through Next.js APIs.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/drops.ts: createTextDrop; createFileDrop; decryptDrop; uploadToR2; deleteFromR2. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/drops.ts

g.title: Workspace membership
g.desc: Shared workspace operations and member information.. Purpose: Shared workspace operations and member information.. How it works: Combines Firebase Auth, Firestore, and workspace key handling.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/workspaces.ts: Firebase imports; getWorkspaceMembers. Uncertainty: Membership behavior was inspected statically, not exercised.. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/workspaces.ts

g.title: Workspace chat
g.desc: Realtime group messages, read state, and mention notifications.. Purpose: Realtime group messages, read state, and mention notifications.. How it works: Subscribes to Firestore messages, sends and edits messages, and calls notification routes.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/groupChat.ts: subscribeToGroupMessages; sendGroupMessage; markWorkspaceChatRead. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/groupChat.ts

g.title: Browser encryption and keys
g.desc: AES-GCM encryption, ECDH key exchange, and browser key storage.. Purpose: AES-GCM encryption, ECDH key exchange, and browser key storage.. How it works: Uses Web Crypto; stores master CryptoKey objects in IndexedDB. Drop and workspace key wrapping is implemented by the neighboring keys module.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/crypto.ts: generateAESKey; generateKeyPair; openDB. Uncertainty: This map is not a cryptographic security audit.. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/crypto.ts

g.title: Cloud Firestore
g.desc: Cloud records for drops, workspaces, messages, users, and related metadata.. Purpose: Cloud records for drops, workspaces, messages, users, and related metadata.. How it works: Client access is governed by Firestore rules; server Admin SDK callers enforce their own authorization.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/firestore.rules: users, profiles and fcmTokens match clauses. Uncertainty: Rules deployment and live database contents were not inspected.. Source: drag-drop-app/firestore.rules

g.title: Firebase Authentication
g.desc: Identity provider for browser sessions and verified API requests.. Purpose: Identity provider for browser sessions and verified API requests.. How it works: Issues identity tokens used by server-side Firebase verification.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/auth.ts: Firebase Auth API imports. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/auth.ts

g.title: Cloudflare R2 objects
g.desc: Object storage for uploaded drop payloads and shared files.. Purpose: Object storage for uploaded drop payloads and shared files.. How it works: S3-compatible R2 client signs uploads; other server routes and backend helpers handle deletion or fetching.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/presign/route.ts: S3Client R2 endpoint; PutObjectCommand. Uncertainty: Actual buckets, credentials, and deployment settings were not read.. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/presign/route.ts

g.title: File transfer APIs
g.desc: Authenticated upload authorization and related file transfer endpoints.. Purpose: Authenticated upload authorization and related file transfer endpoints.. How it works: Verifies a Firebase ID token and returns a signed R2 PUT URL; /api/delete supports drop object cleanup.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/presign/route.ts: POST; getAuth().verifyIdToken; getSignedUrl. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/presign/route.ts

g.title: Public sharing API
g.desc: Server operations supporting public drop share links.. Purpose: Server operations supporting public drop share links.. How it works: Uses Firebase Admin Auth/Firestore and R2 object commands.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/share/route.ts: POST route imports; S3Client; PutObjectCommand; DeleteObjectCommand. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/share/route.ts

g.title: Public share page
g.desc: Separate route for viewing a shared drop.. Purpose: Separate route for viewing a shared drop.. How it works: The shareId route delegates browser presentation to ShareClient.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/s/[shareId]/page.tsx: shareId route; ShareClient. Uncertainty: Detailed public-share authorization and expiry behavior were not tested.. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/s/[shareId]/page.tsx

g.title: Push notification routes
g.desc: Send group-chat push notifications to recipient devices.. Purpose: Send group-chat push notifications to recipient devices.. How it works: Uses Firebase Admin messaging multicast; browser notification support registers tokens through notifications.ts.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/notify-chat-message/route.ts: getMessaging().sendEachForMulticast. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/notify-chat-message/route.ts

g.title: Firebase Cloud Messaging
g.desc: Push delivery and browser notification registration.. Purpose: Push delivery and browser notification registration.. How it works: Client requests messaging tokens; server notification handlers send data-only pushes.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/notifications.ts: getToken; deleteToken; ensureFcmToken. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/notifications.ts

g.title: Live call client
g.desc: Browser audio/video room lifecycle.. Purpose: Browser audio/video room lifecycle.. How it works: Uses the LiveKit client with local media and Firestore call state; remains mounted at page level.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/hooks/useLiveKitCall.ts: Room; RoomEvent; useLiveKitCall. Source: drag-drop-app/src/hooks/useLiveKitCall.ts

g.title: Call control APIs
g.desc: Call authorization, lifecycle, and room administration.. Purpose: Call authorization, lifecycle, and room administration.. How it works: Uses Firebase Admin and LiveKit RoomServiceClient; related routes implement join, token, leave, enforcement, and webhook handling.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/call/_lib.ts: getLiveKitRoomService; RoomServiceClient. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/call/_lib.ts

g.title: LiveKit media service
g.desc: Remote room signaling and media transport.. Purpose: Remote room signaling and media transport.. How it works: Browser Room instances use LiveKit; server room administration and webhook routes manage call lifecycle.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/hooks/useLiveKitCall.ts: LiveKit Room imports. Uncertainty: Service configuration and runtime connectivity were not inspected.. Source: drag-drop-app/src/hooks/useLiveKitCall.ts
g.text: Remote room signaling and media t...

g.title: Daily call enforcement
g.desc: Scheduled call-limit enforcement entry point.. Purpose: Scheduled call-limit enforcement entry point.. How it works: The Vercel cron configuration targets /api/call/enforce at 0 0 * * *.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/vercel.json: crons path and schedule. Uncertainty: Configuration establishes the schedule; execution history was not checked.. Source: drag-drop-app/vercel.json

g.title: Web backup workflows
g.desc: Import and export encrypted personal/workspace .dropsync archives.. Purpose: Import and export encrypted personal/workspace .dropsync archives.. How it works: Uses ZIP streams, archiveFormat envelopes, Firestore records, drop payload helpers, and recovery/import fences.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/lib/personalArchive.ts: exportPersonalArchive; importPersonalArchive; archiveFormat imports. Source: drag-drop-app/src/lib/personalArchive.ts

g.title: Encrypted .dropsync archive
g.desc: Portable backup format shared by web and desktop.. Purpose: Portable backup format shared by web and desktop.. How it works: DROPSYNC envelope wraps password-derived, chunked AES-GCM data; desktop code documents byte compatibility with web archiveFormat.ts.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/envelope.ts: ARCHIVE_EXTENSION; byte-compatibility contract. Uncertainty: Compatibility is supported by source contracts; no cross-app round trip was run.. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/envelope.ts

g.title: AI chat panel
g.desc: Browser interface for assistant conversation and agent activity.. Purpose: Browser interface for assistant conversation and agent activity.. How it works: Uses Firebase identity and an environment-configured agent service URL, with a localhost development fallback.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/components/editorial/EditorialChatPanel.tsx: AGENT_URL; auth import. Source: drag-drop-app/src/components/editorial/EditorialChatPanel.tsx

g.title: Agent FastAPI service
g.desc: Authenticated AI requests and resumable streaming runs.. Purpose: Authenticated AI requests and resumable streaming runs.. How it works: Verifies Firebase tokens, applies usage gates, clones request agents, and launches a fresh identity-bound MCP subprocess; offers /chat and /chat/runs routes.. Evidence: agent-backend/src/main.py: verify_user; MCPServerStdio; Runner.run_streamed; /chat/runs. Uncertainty: Run state durability across service restarts was not established.. Source: agent-backend/src/main.py

g.title: Assistant and knowledge agents
g.desc: LLM orchestration, app knowledge, and password-related guardrail.. Purpose: LLM orchestration, app knowledge, and password-related guardrail.. How it works: Uses Agents SDK agent definitions and guardrail Runner calls with model/client configuration imported from config.. Evidence: agent-backend/src/agent.py: Agent; input_guardrail; Runner; dropsync_agent; knowledge_agent. Uncertainty: The live provider/model was not queried.. Source: agent-backend/src/agent.py

g.title: Per-request MCP tools
g.desc: Authorized tools for drop and workspace operations.. Purpose: Authorized tools for drop and workspace operations.. How it works: FastMCP exposes search/read/create/update/delete operations; checks the verified caller and uses Firestore, crypto, R2, and YouTube helpers.. Evidence: agent-backend/src/tools_server.py: FastMCP; list_drops; search_drops; create_drop; delete_drop. Source: agent-backend/src/tools_server.py
g.text: Authorized tools for drop and wor...

g.title: Configured LLM endpoint
g.desc: Model inference provider selected by backend configuration.. Purpose: Model inference provider selected by backend configuration.. How it works: Agents use llm_client, model and MODEL_NAME imported from config.. Evidence: agent-backend/src/agent.py: from config import llm_client, model, MODEL_NAME. Uncertainty: No environment contents were read; current deployed provider is unknown.. Source: agent-backend/src/agent.py

g.title: Voice transcription API
g.desc: Authenticated audio transcription with per-user usage limits.. Purpose: Authenticated audio transcription with per-user usage limits.. How it works: Forwards audio to Groq through the server and tracks quota in Firestore.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/transcribe/route.ts: VOICE_DAILY_LIMIT; VOICE_MAX_BYTES; isTrustedVoiceCaller. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/transcribe/route.ts

g.title: Groq speech API
g.desc: External speech-to-text provider for voice input.. Purpose: External speech-to-text provider for voice input.. How it works: Receives server-forwarded caller audio through the transcription route.. Evidence: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/transcribe/route.ts: transcription route Groq integration. Uncertainty: No live request was made.. Source: drag-drop-app/src/app/api/transcribe/route.ts

g.title: Desktop local interface
g.desc: React renderer for local spaces, drops, previews, setup, and unlock.. Purpose: React renderer for local spaces, drops, previews, setup, and unlock.. How it works: Uses VaultStoreProvider and modal components; supports cloud/local mode selection through the preload bridge.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/renderer/src/App.tsx: App; VaultStoreProvider; DesktopMode. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/renderer/src/App.tsx

g.title: Electron preload bridge
g.desc: Restricted renderer-to-main capability boundary.. Purpose: Restricted renderer-to-main capability boundary.. How it works: Exposes contextBridge promise APIs over ipcRenderer.invoke for vault, drop, archive, and update operations.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/preload/index.ts: contextBridge; invoke; api.vault; api.drop. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/preload/index.ts

g.title: Electron main process
g.desc: Desktop entry point, windows, privileged IPC, and media protocol.. Purpose: Desktop entry point, windows, privileged IPC, and media protocol.. How it works: Owns VaultManager, archive operations, updater and cloud views; registers the media scheme before app readiness.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/index.ts: VaultManager import; protocol.registerSchemesAsPrivileged; ipcMain. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/index.ts

g.title: Embedded cloud mode
g.desc: Electron WebContentsView hosting the deployed DropSync web app.. Purpose: Electron WebContentsView hosting the deployed DropSync web app.. How it works: Uses CLOUD_URL and a separate cloud view plus overlay views.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/cloud.ts: CLOUD_URL; WebContentsView. Uncertainty: This is web embedding; source does not establish automatic cloud/local vault synchronization.. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/cloud.ts

g.title: Vault manager
g.desc: Main-process owner of local encrypted vault state.. Purpose: Main-process owner of local encrypted vault state.. How it works: Creates/unlocks/locks vaults and serves requested payloads; uses encrypted index, blob storage and opaque media tokens.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/vault.ts: VaultManager; blobsDir; media token state. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/vault.ts

g.title: Encrypted vault index
g.desc: Sealed local metadata snapshot and mutation journal in vault.vmeta.. Purpose: Sealed local metadata snapshot and mutation journal in vault.vmeta.. How it works: Loads an encrypted snapshot plus authenticated append-only journal; atomic compaction and torn-tail recovery maintain the index.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/indexStore.ts: vault.vmeta format; journal and snapshot operations. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/indexStore.ts

g.title: Encrypted blob storage
g.desc: Local .vblob attachment and oversized-text files.. Purpose: Local .vblob attachment and oversized-text files.. How it works: Uses chunked authenticated envelopes and supports range reads for media seeking.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/blobStore.ts: BLOB_MAGIC; BLOB_CHUNK_SIZE; envelope transforms. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/blobStore.ts

g.title: Desktop archive adapters
g.desc: Validate/import web-compatible archives and export vault spaces.. Purpose: Validate/import web-compatible archives and export vault spaces.. How it works: Importer reads .dropsync sources into VaultManager with crash recovery; exporter.ts writes compatible encrypted archives.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/importer.ts: inspectArchive; importArchive; recoverInterruptedImport; loadArchiveFromSource. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/vault/importer.ts

g.title: Desktop updater
g.desc: User-directed desktop update lifecycle.. Purpose: User-directed desktop update lifecycle.. How it works: Uses electron-updater and fetches GitHub release notes; exposes check, download, cancel and install operations.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/updater.ts: wireUpdater; checkForUpdate; installUpdate; GITHUB_LATEST_API. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/updater.ts

g.title: GitHub release feed
g.desc: Desktop release metadata and update distribution integration.. Purpose: Desktop release metadata and update distribution integration.. How it works: The updater references the dropsync-desktop GitHub releases endpoint.. Evidence: dropsync-desktop/src/main/updater.ts: GITHUB_LATEST_API; RELEASES_PAGE. Uncertainty: Feed availability and published binaries were not verified.. Source: dropsync-desktop/src/main/updater.ts
